description: With all of the various animal species roaming around the planet there's a lot to know about animals, which means no one knows everything about them. Have you ever wondered if birds can fly backward, how animals without external ears hear, or why zebras have stripes? Those are among the questions waiting for answers on "Zoo Clues.".
